show_hn.title: Show HN: SpongeHome – ADHD-Friendly Task and Focus Tool with AI and Stress Games

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I built *SpongeHome*, a productivity and focus tool designed for ADHD and anxiety-prone users. Unlike traditional task managers, SpongeHome integrates *AI-powered task breakdown, stress relief mini-games, and a privacy-first design* to help users stay on track without feeling overwhelmed.

###  What makes SpongeHome different?  
- *Two unique stress-relief modes:*  
  1. *Shout Mode* – Yell to score points and beat imaginary enemies (uses offline voice recognition).  
  2. *Bubble Pop Mode* – Tap a sponge to release and burst bubbles, simulating a relaxing bath-time experience.

- *AI Task Management*  
  - Auto-breaks down tasks into *small, dopamine-friendly steps*  
  - Smart categorization to reduce decision fatigue  
  - Privacy-first: No cloud sync, fully local

###  Why I built this  
As someone struggling with focus and procrastination, I found that traditional to-do apps felt overwhelming. Many ADHD users need *low-friction, playful ways to start tasks* rather than complex workflows. SpongeHome is my attempt to make productivity fun, engaging, and stress-free.

Would love to hear feedback from the community – especially if you’ve struggled with focus, ADHD, or just want a fresh take on task management!
